Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1- The bidders must required to upload all relevant documents/certificates issued by competent authority of Uttar Pradesh Government Officials.

2- Experience certificate is must for all types of bidders. Work Order would not be considered as experienc e certificate. 3- EMD is Mandatory for all types of bidders.
